# Trustflow v0 starter
> Next.js scaffold shaped like a v0 community template, with a placeholder did:web identity. Replace REPLACE_ME before you publish the site.

Domain: REPLACE_ME.example

## Services
- Home page (/)
- Site header (components/site-header.tsx)

## Identity
- DID: did:web:REPLACE_ME.example
- Manifest: https://REPLACE_ME.example/.well-known/did.json

## Trust

Agents should call verifyDomain before tool invocation.
